NJ, NYC & the tri-state area

Custom apparel across the tri-state area

Meadow Prints & Embroidery is based in Monmouth County, New Jersey and works with businesses, crews, teams and schools across New Jersey, New York City, Westchester, Long Island and Connecticut. We screen print and embroider custom t-shirts, work shirts, hoodies, hats and uniforms and deliver them wherever you are.

What we do

Services across the tri-state area

Screen Printing

Bold, durable prints that get more affordable per shirt as the order grows.

Custom Embroidery

Stitched logos for polos, hats, jackets and bags with a premium finish.

Custom T-Shirts

Tees for teams, events and businesses, from one-offs to hundreds.

Hats & Caps

Truckers, snapbacks and beanies, embroidered or patched.

Hoodies & Outerwear

Hoodies, crews, quarter-zips and jackets for crews and fans.

Team & Spirit Wear

Uniforms, warmups and fan gear with names and numbers.
